name: Healing Sphere
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 3, druid 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one orb of positive energy
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will half (harmless); see text; Spell Resistance yes (harmless); see text

DESCRIPTION

A glowing blue orb of positive energy forms in your hand and flies unerringly toward any one willing creature you designate. The orb heals the targeted creature of 2d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum of +10). Since undead are powered by negative energy, you can use this spell to deal damage to an undead creature with a successful ranged touch attack. An undead creature can apply spell resistance and attempt a Will save for half damage.
